[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Query Kth Smallest Trimmed Number** [LC 2343 · Query Kth Smallest Trimmed Number](https://leetcode.com/problems/query-kth-smallest-trimmed-number/){difficulty="Medium"}

"Trim to the rightmost $t$ digits and sort" is exactly the state LSD radix sort is in after $t$ passes (@sec-lts-a3): it has sorted by the last $t$ digits and has not looked at the rest yet. And the tie rule "lower index first" is exactly what **stability** gives for free if the list starts in index order. So run one LSD radix sort over all $L$ columns, save the order after every pass, and each query becomes a lookup: the answer to $[k, t]$ is entry $k - 1$ of the order saved after pass $t$.

[Solved in full in @sec-lts-p6-b.]{.card-link}

:::
